gloss: to turn one's attention to; to look toward

definitions.gloss: to look toward; to turn one's eyes to
definitions.explanation: To physically direct one's gaze toward something.

definitions.gloss: to turn one's attention to; to pay attention to; to focus on
definitions.explanation: To direct one's awareness or interest toward an issue, topic, or aspect. The figurative meaning is more common.

examples.english: I turned my eyes toward the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{向|む}けた。

examples.english: When I looked toward the voice, my friend was standing there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{向|む}ける。
examples.english: To turn one's attention to environmental issues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{目|め}を{向|む}ける⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to turn our attention overseas as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{目|め}を{向|む}けるべきだ。
examples.english: We should pay more attention to the cause of the problem.

notes:
Literally 'to direct one's eyes toward.' The figurative sense (paying attention to an issue or topic) is more common in written and formal Japanese. The expression emphasizes a deliberate, conscious act of focusing attention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{向|む}ける: to face reality
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{向|む}ける: to look toward the future
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{向|む}ける: to turn attention to a problem
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{向|む}ける: to look out at the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}する→注目する：25530_chuumokusuru⟧: to pay attention to — more about focusing closely on something noteworthy
- {目|め}を{向|む}ける is about deliberately directing attention, often toward something previously overlooked
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そらす: to look away; to avert one's eyes — the opposite action
